verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for an observability SaaS with agents, collectors and APIs, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any setting to disable product telemetry or usage tracking. The SSO, password and IP protection features are access controls, not telemetry opt-outs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
